project.name: Modern Coffee Shop
project.summary: A modern, inviting coffee shop website featuring a hero section with brand messaging, a visual menu showcasing coffee offerings, and a contact form for customer inquiries. The design emphasizes warm brown and cream tones to create a cozy café atmosphere.
project.purpose: To establish an online presence for a coffee shop, showcase their menu offerings, and provide customers with an easy way to get in touch or find location information.
project.primaryGoal: Encourage visitors to visit the physical café or contact for inquiries

assumptions: Menu is a visual-only product listing (no online ordering/cart functionality)
Contact form will use client-side validation only (no backend integration for form submissions)
Hero section includes call-to-action to view menu or find location
Menu displays coffee categories (espresso, brewed, specialty drinks)
Contact form includes basic fields: name, email, message, and possibly reservation preferences

colorDirection.primary: Rich brown (#654321 or similar coffee brown)

designSystem.typographyDirection: Clean, readable sans-serif fonts with handcrafted or script accent font for headings
designSystem.imagery: High-quality coffee photography, warm lighting, rustic textures, latte art close-ups

content.tone: Warm, welcoming, and artisanal - emphasizing quality, craftsmanship, and community
headlineIdeas: Crafted with Care, Served with Love
Where Every Cup Tells a Story
requiredContent: Menu item names, descriptions, and prices

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays compelling headline and call-to-action on all devices
Menu displays at least 3 coffee categories with individual items
Contact form validates required fields before submission
Site maintains brown and cream color scheme throughout
All sections are accessible via navigation on mobile and desktop
Images load properly and have appropriate alt text
Site is fully responsive from mobile (320px) to desktop (1440px+)

plan.architectureSummary: A single-page React + Mantine coffee shop website with three main sections (Hero, Menu, Contact) composed by App.jsx. Uses Mantine's theme system for warm brown/cream styling, with reusable components for navigation, coffee items, and form validation. Menu data is stored in a content file, with category tabs for filtering and lightbox for image viewing.

files.responsibility: Contains coffee shop content including menu items with categories (espresso, brewed, specialty), business contact information, opening hours, and social media handles
Mantine theme configuration with custom brown and cream color palette, typography settings, and component default styles
Formats coffee prices for display with currency symbol and proper decimal places
Validates contact form fields (name, email, message) and returns validation errors for display
Responsive navigation bar with smooth scroll links to Hero, Menu, and Contact sections, collapses to hamburger menu on mobile
Footer component displaying business hours, address, and social media links
Displays individual coffee item with image, name, description, price, and click handler for lightbox preview
Tab component for filtering menu items by coffee category (espresso, brewed, specialty)
Modal component for displaying enlarged coffee images with close functionality
Hero banner with headline, subheadline, call-to-action buttons, and background coffee imagery with smooth scroll functionality
Menu section container with category tabs and grid of CoffeeCard components, manages active category state
Contact form with name, email, message fields, business information display, and client-side validation feedback
Root component that composes Navbar, HeroSection, MenuSection, ContactSection, and Footer into a single-page layout

prompt: A modern coffee shop site with hero, menu and contact form.brown and cream colors
